translation: Flavor salty, non-toxic. It mainly supplements deficiency and damage and the five kinds of exhaustion [五勞], removes fullness of the five viscera, raises yin qi, stops seminal emission, wasting-thirst [消渴] and dribbling strangury [淋瀝], and expels retained water of the bladder and triple burner. Bian Que said: "Taking too much harms the patient's eyes."
